entities.summary: Agnes Lawson-Stevenson was a British chess player. She was four-time British Ladies' Champion, and married to Rufus Henry Streatfeild Stevenson, home news editor of the British Chess Magazine, secretary of the Southern Counties Chess Union and match captain of the Kent County Chess Association.
